name: Kitchen Ideas 16-in-1 Veggie Slicer
description: Multifunctional Utility: The set typically includes up to 16 different pieces, featuring a variety of interchangeable 420-grade stainless steel blades for tasks like chopping, shredding, dicing, and julienne cutting.Integrated Container: It features a built-in 1.2L collection tray that allows you to cut food directly into the base, minimizing countertop mess.Safety Features: Most models include a hand guard or safety handle to protect fingers from the sharp blades during use.Material: The body is typically constructed from high-quality, food-grade ABS or polycarbonate plastic, which is designed to be durable and BPA-free.
